products.notes: Community edition with no cost. All certifications apply.

products.name: Zoho Projects (Standard/Professional/Business)
products.data_scope: Full project collaboration, time tracking, resource management, custom fields with PII marking
products.notes: Paid tiers with increasing feature sets. Support for GDPR, HIPAA, CCPA. Optional encryption of custom fields marked as PII.

products.name: Zoho Projects + Zia AI
products.data_scope: Incorporates AI-powered features for task automation, insights, and recommendations
products.notes: Customer data NOT used to train Zia models. AI processing stays within Zoho infrastructure. No model training on customer data.

compare.pricing_model: Freemium subscription: Free, Standard ($45/month), Professional ($75/month), Business ($125/month). Per-user and per-project pricing options available.
compare.data_residency: Cloud-hosted SaaS only. Multiple geographic regions available including EU (via zoho.eu), US, India, and others. Customers can choose region at signup.
